page.overview:
Who is Kande Inabikari?

Kande is a laidback boy with confidence in his abilities.

Kande is an average-height child with fair skin and yellow eyes. He also has blue messy hair with strands standing about. He wears a white hoodie and pants with a simple brown bracelet on his left wrist.

While only just starting in the Academy, Kande has rather adept skill in Lightning Release, able to generate it from his hair and launch bolts accurately to start a fire for cooking.

Kande attended the Academy opening ceremony as part of a new class. His classroom was put under the care of new teacher Hana Kaka. His class included many children of famous people, including the daughter of an acting duo, the daughter of the Seventh Hokage, and Kae Yukiwari, the princess of the Land of Bamboo. The class also included Kawaki, a noticeably older student.
